incipit_diplomatic: Радуйся дѣво похвало вселенныя, радуйся чистая мати христа бога, радуйся скиніе божественныя славы, радуйся горо приосѣненная, тя непрестанно пѣсньми величаемъ.
incipit_english: Rejoice, O Virgin, boast of the universe; rejoice, pure Mother of Christ God; rejoice, tabernacle of divine glory
musical_paleography: Kyivan square notation (київська нота); Scribe Hand A (fine Ukrainian semi-uncial півустав); 12 rastrum-ruled staves per page; C-clef on 3rd/2nd line; Custodes at staff ends
philology_art_concordance: Authentic Kyivan Recension; Yas. № 38 (Варшава, БН, 12052 III)

incipit_diplomatic: Твое спасеніе поюще молимъ тя неизреченную славу, да сподобиши ны царствія небеснаго, вѣрою и любовію тя величающія.
incipit_english: Hymning Thy salvation, we beseech Thy ineffable glory, that Thou vouchsafe us the heavenly kingdom
musical_paleography: Kyivan square notation (київська нота); Scribe Hand A (fine Ukrainian semi-uncial півустав); 12 rastrum-ruled staves per page; C-clef on 3rd/2nd line; Custodes at staff ends
philology_art_concordance: Authentic Kyivan Recension; Yas. № 38 (Варшава, БН, 12052 III)

incipit_diplomatic: Ѡ мати дѣво богородице чистая... утишися смути ся новий Іероусалимъ, сіяетъ бо слава господня на тебѣ.
incipit_english: O Mother Virgin, pure Theotokos... be stilled, O new Jerusalem, for the glory of the Lord hath shone upon thee
musical_paleography: Kyivan square notation (київська нота); Scribe Hand A (fine Ukrainian semi-uncial півустав); 12 rastrum-ruled staves per page; C-clef on 3rd/2nd line; Custodes at staff ends
philology_art_concordance: Authentic Kyivan Recension; Yas. № 38 (Варшава, БН, 12052 III)

incipit_diplomatic: Грядѣте людіе поимъ пѣснь христу богу, раздѣльшему море и наставльшему люди, яже изведе изъ работы египетскія, яко прославися.
incipit_reconstructed: Грядѣте людіе поимъ пѣснь христу богу
incipit_english: Come, ye people, let us sing a song to Christ God, Who divided the sea and led the people whom He brought out of Egyptian bondage
musical_paleography: Kyivan square notation (київська нота); Scribe Hand A (fine Ukrainian semi-uncial півустав); 12 rastrum-ruled staves per page; C-clef on 3rd/2nd line; Custodes at staff ends
philology_art_concordance: Authentic Kyivan Recension; Yas. № 38 (Варшава, БН, 12052 III)

incipit_diplomatic: Помози господи въ чюдо... яко дѣва породи бога вочеловѣчшася, тому поимъ пѣснь побѣдную яко прославися.
incipit_english: Help, O Lord, in wonder... for the Virgin bore God incarnate; unto Him let us sing a victorious song
musical_paleography: Kyivan square notation (київська нота); Scribe Hand A (fine Ukrainian semi-uncial півустав); 12 rastrum-ruled staves per page; C-clef on 3rd/2nd line; Custodes at staff ends
philology_art_concordance: Authentic Kyivan Recension; Yas. № 38 (Варшава, БН, 12052 III)

incipit_diplomatic: Богъ уби нагло потопи древле фараонитскаго воина во глубинѣ морстѣй, мы же спасени поимъ пѣснь победную яко прославися.
incipit_english: God suddenly drowned of old the chariot-warriors of Pharaoh in the depths of the sea; and we, being saved, sing a victorious song
musical_paleography: Kyivan square notation (київська нота); Scribe Hand A (fine Ukrainian semi-uncial півустав); 12 rastrum-ruled staves per page; C-clef on 3rd/2nd line; Custodes at staff ends
philology_art_concordance: Authentic Kyivan Recension; Yas. № 38 (Варшава, БН, 12052 III)

incipit_diplomatic: Нетрену необычную шествовавъ стезю израиль по суху во глубинахъ морскихъ...
incipit_english: Treading an untrodden, unusual path, Israel walked on dry land through the depths of the sea
liturgical_title: Beheading of St. John the Baptist, Irmos Ode 1
musical_paleography: Kyivan square notation (київська нота); Scribe Hand A (fine Ukrainian semi-uncial півустав); 12 rastrum-ruled staves per page; C-clef on 3rd/2nd line; Custodes at staff ends
philology_art_concordance: Authentic Kyivan Recension; Yas. № 38 (Варшава, БН, 12052 III)

incipit_diplomatic: Мойсейскую пѣснь прийми душе: помощникъ и покровитель бысть мнѣ во спасеніе, сеи мои богъ и прославлю его, богъ отца моего и вознесу его, славно бо прославися.
incipit_english: Receive the song of Moses, O my soul: Helper and protector was He unto my salvation; He is my God, and I will glorify Him
musical_paleography: Kyivan square notation (київська нота); Scribe Hand A (fine Ukrainian semi-uncial півустав); 12 rastrum-ruled staves per page; C-clef on 3rd/2nd line; Custodes at staff ends
philology_art_concordance: Authentic Kyivan Recension; Yas. № 38 (Варшава, БН, 12052 III)

incipit_diplomatic: Во мори подуну... море древле люди наставлявше, во глубинахъ путь сотворивый христе, спасый рабы своя яко прославися.
incipit_english: He breathed upon the sea... guiding the people of old, Who madest a path in the deep, O Christ
musical_paleography: Kyivan square notation (київська нота); Scribe Hand A (fine Ukrainian semi-uncial півустав); 12 rastrum-ruled staves per page; C-clef on 3rd/2nd line; Custodes at staff ends
philology_art_concordance: Authentic Kyivan Recension; Yas. № 38 (Варшава, БН, 12052 III)

incipit_diplomatic: Глубины откры море божіимъ мановеніемъ, и по суху сподоби люди прейти, избавивъ от фараона, тому поимъ яко прославися.
incipit_english: The depths of the sea opened at the nod of God, and He vouchsafed the people to cross on dry land, delivering them from Pharaoh
musical_paleography: Kyivan square notation (київська нота); Scribe Hand A (fine Ukrainian semi-uncial півустав); 12 rastrum-ruled staves per page; C-clef on 3rd/2nd line; Custodes at staff ends
philology_art_concordance: Authentic Kyivan Recension; Yas. № 38 (Варшава, БН, 12052 III)

incipit_diplomatic: Поимъ господеви пѣснь новую яко преславно прославися, коня и всадника вверже въ море, помощникъ и покровитель бысть мнѣ во спасеніе.
incipit_english: Let us sing unto the Lord a new song, for gloriously hath He been glorified; horse and rider hath He thrown into the sea
musical_paleography: Kyivan square notation (київська нота); Scribe Hand A (fine Ukrainian semi-uncial півустав); 12 rastrum-ruled staves per page; C-clef on 3rd/2nd line; Custodes at staff ends
philology_art_concordance: Authentic Kyivan Recension; Yas. № 38 (Варшава, БН, 12052 III)

incipit_diplomatic: Непроходимо волнующееся море божіимъ повелѣніемъ изсушися, люди же изведе пешцы сквозѣ глубь, вопіющія: поимъ господеви славно бо прославися.
incipit_english: The impassable surging sea dried up at God's command, and He led the people on foot through the deep
musical_paleography: Kyivan square notation (київська нота); Scribe Hand A (fine Ukrainian semi-uncial півустав); 12 rastrum-ruled staves per page; C-clef on 3rd/2nd line; Custodes at staff ends
philology_art_concordance: Authentic Kyivan Recension; Yas. № 38 (Варшава, БН, 12052 III)

incipit_diplomatic: Видите видите яко азъ есмь богъ вашъ, иже прежде вѣкъ рожденный от отца, и въ послѣдняя же лѣта от дѣвы безъ сѣмене заченшися, и смерти державу разрушихъ.
incipit_reconstructed: Видите видите яко азъ есмь богъ
incipit_english: See, see that I am your God, born of the Father before the ages, and in these latter times conceived without seed of the Virgin
liturgical_title: Great Canon of St. Andrew of Crete Ode 2 (Melodic Variant)
musical_paleography: Kyivan square notation (київська нота); Scribe Hand A (fine Ukrainian semi-uncial півустав); 12 rastrum-ruled staves per page; C-clef on 3rd/2nd line; Custodes at staff ends
philology_art_concordance: Authentic Kyivan Recension; Yas. № 38 (Варшава, БН, 12052 III)

incipit_diplomatic: Паки и паки небеса веселятся, и концы земля радуются, видяще божіе смотреніе: яко во плоти явися спасти человѣка.
incipit_english: Again and again the heavens rejoice, and the ends of the earth are glad, beholding the dispensation of God
musical_paleography: Kyivan square notation (київська нота); Scribe Hand A (fine Ukrainian semi-uncial півустав); 12 rastrum-ruled staves per page; C-clef on 3rd/2nd line; Custodes at staff ends
philology_art_concordance: Authentic Kyivan Recension; Yas. № 38 (Варшава, БН, 12052 III)

incipit_diplomatic: Божественнѣй пѣсни приносите люди господеви, иже избави насъ от работы грѣховныя, тому единому поимъ во вся вѣки.
incipit_english: Bring divine songs unto the Lord, ye people, Who delivered us from the bondage of sin; unto Him alone let us sing unto all ages
musical_paleography: Kyivan square notation (київська нота); Scribe Hand A (fine Ukrainian semi-uncial півустав); 12 rastrum-ruled staves per page; C-clef on 3rd/2nd line; Custodes at staff ends
philology_art_concordance: Authentic Kyivan Recension; Yas. № 38 (Варшава, БН, 12052 III)

incipit_diplomatic: Воньмѣте людіе знаменіе спасительное, егоже сотвори богъ нашъ на земли, разрѣшивъ клятву праотца адама.
incipit_english: Take heed, ye people, unto the saving sign which our God wrought upon earth, loosing the curse of Forefather Adam
musical_paleography: Kyivan square notation (київська нота); Scribe Hand A (fine Ukrainian semi-uncial півустав); 12 rastrum-ruled staves per page; C-clef on 3rd/2nd line; Custodes at staff ends
philology_art_concordance: Authentic Kyivan Recension; Yas. № 38 (Варшава, БН, 12052 III)

incipit_diplomatic: Утверженіе твоего и недвижимое реченій твоихъ Христе, утверди сердца наша во страсѣ твоемъ, кромѣ бо тебе богъ нѣсть.
incipit_english: By the steadfastness and immovable nature of Thy words, O Christ, establish our hearts in Thy fear
musical_paleography: Kyivan square notation (київська нота); Scribe Hand A (fine Ukrainian semi-uncial півустав); 12 rastrum-ruled staves per page; C-clef on 3rd/2nd line; Custodes at staff ends
philology_art_concordance: Authentic Kyivan Recension; Yas. № 38 (Варшава, БН, 12052 III)

incipit_diplomatic: На камени мя вѣры утверди и разшири уста моя на враги моя, возвесели бо ся духъ мои внегда пѣти: нѣсть святъ якоже богъ нашъ, и нѣсть праведенъ паче тебе господи.
incipit_english: Establish me upon the rock of faith and enlarge my mouth against my enemies; for my spirit rejoiceth when I sing: none is holy as our God
musical_paleography: Kyivan square notation (київська нота); Scribe Hand A (fine Ukrainian semi-uncial півустав); 12 rastrum-ruled staves per page; C-clef on 3rd/2nd line; Custodes at staff ends
philology_art_concordance: Authentic Kyivan Recension; Yas. № 38 (Варшава, БН, 12052 III)

incipit_diplomatic: Процвѣла есть пустыни яко кринъ господи языческая неплодящая церковь пришествіемъ твоимъ, въ неиже утвердися сердце мое.
incipit_english: The wilderness, the barren church of the nations, hath blossomed as a lily at Thy coming, O Lord
musical_paleography: Kyivan square notation (київська нота); Scribe Hand A (fine Ukrainian semi-uncial півустав); 12 rastrum-ruled staves per page; C-clef on 3rd/2nd line; Custodes at staff ends
philology_art_concordance: Authentic Kyivan Recension; Yas. № 38 (Варшава, БН, 12052 III)

incipit_diplomatic: Крѣпость дая княземъ нашимъ господи и рогъ помазанныхъ твоихъ возносяи, от дѣвы раждаяся, утверди нашу мысль во славу твою.
incipit_english: Giving strength unto our rulers, O Lord, and exalting the horn of Thine anointed, born of the Virgin, establish our minds
musical_paleography: Kyivan square notation (київська нота); Scribe Hand A (fine Ukrainian semi-uncial півустав); 12 rastrum-ruled staves per page; C-clef on 3rd/2nd line; Custodes at staff ends
philology_art_concordance: Authentic Kyivan Recension; Yas. № 38 (Варшава, БН, 12052 III)

incipit_diplomatic: Елицы древнихъ разорѣхомся сѣтей брашна лютаго, поимъ христу спасителю: нѣсть бо святъ паче тебе человѣколюбче.
incipit_english: As many of us as were delivered from the ancient snares of the bitter food, let us sing unto Christ the Savior
musical_paleography: Kyivan square notation (київська нота); Scribe Hand A (fine Ukrainian semi-uncial півустав); 12 rastrum-ruled staves per page; C-clef on 3rd/2nd line; Custodes at staff ends
philology_art_concordance: Pre-Nikonian Authentic Kyivan Recension; Yas. № 38 (Варшава, БН, 12052 III)

incipit_diplomatic: Неплоднаго ми ума плодоносна боже покажи, дѣлателю добрыхъ и насадителю благихъ, благоутробіемъ твоимъ.
incipit_english: Show my barren mind to be fruitful, O God, Cultivator of good things and Planter of virtues
liturgical_title: Sunday of Myrrh-bearers Canon Irmos Ode 3 (Tone 2)
musical_paleography: Kyivan square notation (київська нота); Scribe Hand A (fine Ukrainian semi-uncial півустав); 12 rastrum-ruled staves per page; C-clef on 3rd/2nd line; Custodes at staff ends
philology_art_concordance: Authentic Kyivan Recension; Yas. № 38 (Варшава, БН, 12052 III)

incipit_diplomatic: Утверди насъ себе господи древомъ умертвивъ грѣхъ, и страхъ твои всади въ сердца наша поющихъ тя.
incipit_english: Establish us in Thee, O Lord, having slain sin by the Tree, and plant Thy fear in the hearts of us that hymn Thee
musical_paleography: Kyivan square notation (київська нота); Scribe Hand A (fine Ukrainian semi-uncial півустав); 12 rastrum-ruled staves per page; C-clef on 3rd/2nd line; Custodes at staff ends
philology_art_concordance: Authentic Kyivan Recension; Yas. № 38 (Варшава, БН, 12052 III)

incipit_diplomatic: Лукъ сокрушися сильныхъ державою твоею христе, и немощніи препоясашася силою, сего ради утвердися о господѣ сердце мое.
incipit_english: The bow of the mighty was broken by Thy power, O Christ, and the weak girded themselves with strength
liturgical_title: Beheading of St. John the Baptist, Irmos Ode 3
musical_paleography: Kyivan square notation (київська нота); Scribe Hand A (fine Ukrainian semi-uncial півустав); 12 rastrum-ruled staves per page; C-clef on 3rd/2nd line; Custodes at staff ends
philology_art_concordance: Authentic Kyivan Recension; Yas. № 38 (Варшава, БН, 12052 III)

incipit_diplomatic: Пою тя слухомъ господи услышахъ и убояхся, яко от фаранскія горы присѣнныя святыя пришелъ еси христе, слава силѣ твоей господи.
incipit_english: I hymn Thee, O Lord, for I heard the report of Thee and was afraid: that from the overshadowed, holy Mount Paran Thou didst come
musical_paleography: Kyivan square notation (київська нота); Scribe Hand A (fine Ukrainian semi-uncial півустав); 12 rastrum-ruled staves per page; C-clef on 3rd/2nd line; Custodes at staff ends
philology_art_concordance: Authentic Kyivan Recension; Yas. № 38 (Варшава, БН, 12052 III)

incipit_diplomatic: Пришелъ еси от дѣвы ни ходатай ни ангелъ но самъ господи воплощься, и спаслъ еси всего мя человѣка, сѣмъ зову ти: слава силѣ твоей господи.
incipit_english: Thou didst come from the Virgin, neither mediator nor angel, but Thyself, O Lord, incarnate, and hast saved me, whole man
musical_paleography: Kyivan square notation (київська нота); Scribe Hand A (fine Ukrainian semi-uncial півустав); 12 rastrum-ruled staves per page; C-clef on 3rd/2nd line; Custodes at staff ends
philology_art_concordance: Authentic Kyivan Recension; Yas. № 38 (Варшава, БН, 12052 III)

incipit_diplomatic: Услышахъ господи славное твое смотреніе и прославихъ непостижимую твою силу человѣколюбче.
incipit_english: I heard, O Lord, of Thy glorious dispensation, and I glorified Thine incomprehensible power, O Lover of mankind
musical_paleography: Kyivan square notation (київська нота); Scribe Hand A (fine Ukrainian semi-uncial півустав); 12 rastrum-ruled staves per page; C-clef on 3rd/2nd line; Custodes at staff ends
philology_art_concordance: Pre-Nikonian Authentic Kyivan Recension; Yas. № 38 (Варшава, БН, 12052 III)

incipit_diplomatic: Услышахъ господи слухъ твоего смотреніа, и убояхся яко неизреченно от дѣвы воплотися христосъ богъ, слава силѣ твоей господи.
incipit_english: I heard, O Lord, the report of Thy dispensation and was afraid, that ineffably Christ God became incarnate of the Virgin
musical_paleography: Kyivan square notation (київська нота); Scribe Hand A (fine Ukrainian semi-uncial півустав); 12 rastrum-ruled staves per page; C-clef on 3rd/2nd line; Custodes at staff ends
philology_art_concordance: Authentic Kyivan Recension; Yas. № 38 (Варшава, БН, 12052 III)

incipit_diplomatic: Услышахъ господи гласъ твои еже рече: въ пустыни гласъ вопіющаго, оуготовите путь господень, слава силѣ твоей господи.
incipit_english: I heard, O Lord, Thy voice which said: The voice of one crying in the wilderness: Prepare ye the way of the Lord
musical_paleography: Kyivan square notation (київська нота); Scribe Hand A (fine Ukrainian semi-uncial півустав); 12 rastrum-ruled staves per page; C-clef on 3rd/2nd line; Custodes at staff ends
philology_art_concordance: Authentic Kyivan Recension; Yas. № 38 (Варшава, БН, 12052 III)

incipit_diplomatic: Шедъ гласъ словесе свѣтильникъ зря, предтеча на іорданѣ вопіяше: приидите вси и видите христа спасающего свѣтъ.
incipit_english: The voice of the Word going forth, beholding the Lamp, the Forerunner on the Jordan cried: Come all and behold Christ
musical_paleography: Kyivan square notation (київська нота); Scribe Hand A (fine Ukrainian semi-uncial півустав); 12 rastrum-ruled staves per page; C-clef on 3rd/2nd line; Custodes at staff ends
philology_art_concordance: Authentic Kyivan Recension; Yas. № 38 (Варшава, БН, 12052 III)

incipit_diplomatic: Егда приближишася лѣта, познанъ бысть христосъ спаситель нашъ, пророчестіи гласи исполнишася, слава силѣ твоей господи.
incipit_english: When the years drew near, Christ our Savior was made known, the prophetic voices were fulfilled
musical_paleography: Kyivan square notation (київська нота); Scribe Hand A (fine Ukrainian semi-uncial півустав); 12 rastrum-ruled staves per page; C-clef on 3rd/2nd line; Custodes at staff ends
philology_art_concordance: Authentic Kyivan Recension; Yas. № 38 (Варшава, БН, 12052 III)

incipit_diplomatic: Иже от дѣвицы твое рожество пророкъ предзря аввакумъ, проповѣдаше вопія: услышахъ слухъ твои господи и убояхся.
incipit_english: Foreseeing Thy birth from the Virgin, the Prophet Habakkuk preached, crying: I heard Thy report, O Lord, and was afraid
musical_paleography: Kyivan square notation (київська нота); Scribe Hand A (fine Ukrainian semi-uncial півустав); 12 rastrum-ruled staves per page; C-clef on 3rd/2nd line; Custodes at staff ends
philology_art_concordance: Authentic Kyivan Recension; Yas. № 38 (Варшава, БН, 12052 III)

incipit_diplomatic: Услышахъ слухъ пришествія твоего Христе, и убояхся яко пришелъ еси спасти родъ человѣческій, слава силѣ твоей господи.
incipit_english: I heard the report of Thy coming, O Christ, and was afraid, for Thou didst come to save the human race
musical_paleography: Kyivan square notation (київська нота); Scribe Hand A (fine Ukrainian semi-uncial півустав); 12 rastrum-ruled staves per page; C-clef on 3rd/2nd line; Custodes at staff ends
philology_art_concordance: Authentic Kyivan Recension; Yas. № 38 (Варшава, БН, 12052 III)

incipit_diplomatic: Ходатаи богу и человѣкомъ бысть Христе боже: тобою бо владыко къ свѣтоначальнику отцу твоему от нощи невѣдѣнія приведеніе имамы.
incipit_english: A Mediator between God and men hast Thou become, O Christ God; for through Thee, O Master, we have access from the night of ignorance
musical_paleography: Kyivan square notation (київська нота); Scribe Hand A (fine Ukrainian semi-uncial півустав); 12 rastrum-ruled staves per page; C-clef on 3rd/2nd line; Custodes at staff ends
philology_art_concordance: Authentic Kyivan Recension; Yas. № 38 (Варшава, БН, 12052 III)

incipit_diplomatic: Людемъ въ полунощи наставша христе свѣтомъ пришествія твоего, просвѣти омраченная сердца наша, от нощи утренюющимъ ти.
incipit_english: Guiding the people at midnight by the light of Thy coming, O Christ, enlighten our darkened hearts
musical_paleography: Kyivan square notation (київська нота); Scribe Hand A (fine Ukrainian semi-uncial півустав); 12 rastrum-ruled staves per page; C-clef on 3rd/2nd line; Custodes at staff ends

musical_paleography: Kyivan square notation (київська нота); Scribe Hand A (fine Ukrainian semi-uncial півустав); 12 rastrum-ruled staves per page; C-clef on 3rd/2nd line; Custodes at staff ends

incipit_diplomatic: Огнь пла[меня]... пещи страшащеся дѣти же прохлажашеся и поюще глаголаху благословенъ еси единъ сый Боже отецъ нашихъ
incipit_english: Fearing the flame of the fiery furnace, yet the children were refreshed, and singing said: Blessed art Thou, the only God of our fathers!
musical_paleography: Kyivan square notation (київська нота); Scribe Hand A (fine Ukrainian semi-uncial півустав); 12 rastrum-ruled staves per page; C-clef on 3rd/2nd line; Custodes at staff ends
philology_art_concordance: Authentic Kyivan Recension; Yas. № 38 (Варшава, БН, 12052 III)

incipit_diplomatic: Юноши припоядившеся огневыхъ мукъ... добле... преложиша и по средѣ... огня поюще... прохлажаеми по[юще]...
incipit_english: The youths, girding themselves against fiery torments, valiantly transformed them, and singing in the midst of fire were refreshed...
musical_paleography: Kyivan square notation (київська нота); Scribe Hand A (fine Ukrainian semi-uncial півустав); 12 rastrum-ruled staves per page; C-clef on 3rd/2nd line; Custodes at staff ends
philology_art_concordance: Authentic Kyivan Recension; Yas. № 38 (Варшава, БН, 12052 III)

incipit_diplomatic: Тѣлу кумирозданному не поклонишася дѣти авраамстіи и искушени бывше яко злато во горнилѣ во пещи же пламене... вопіяху поюще благословенъ Богъ отецъ нашихъ
incipit_english: The children of Abraham bowed not down to the fashioned image, and being tried like gold in the furnace flame, cried aloud: Blessed is the God of our fathers!
musical_paleography: Kyivan square notation (київська нота); Scribe Hand A (fine Ukrainian semi-uncial півустав); 12 rastrum-ruled staves per page; C-clef on 3rd/2nd line; Custodes at staff ends
philology_art_concordance: Authentic Kyivan Recension; Yas. № 38 (Варшава, БН, 12052 III)

incipit_diplomatic: Не предаждь насъ до конца имени Твоего ради и не разори завѣта Твоего и не ѿстави милости Твоея ѿ насъ... Господи Боже отецъ нашихъ препѣтый...
incipit_reconstructed: Не предаждь нас до конца имени Твоего ради
incipit_english: Forsake us not utterly, for Thy name's sake, neither disannul Thy covenant, and take not away Thy mercy from us... O Lord God of our fathers, all-praised!
musical_paleography: Kyivan square notation (київська нота); Scribe Hand A (fine Ukrainian semi-uncial півустав); 12 rastrum-ruled staves per page; C-clef on 3rd/2nd line; Custodes at staff ends
philology_art_concordance: Authentic Kyivan Recension; Yas. № 38 (Варшава, БН, 12052 III)

incipit_diplomatic: ...на ча... словесе...
incipit_english: By Thy word...
musical_paleography: Kyivan square notation (київська нота); Scribe Hand A (fine Ukrainian semi-uncial півустав); 12 rastrum-ruled staves per page; C-clef on 3rd/2nd line; Custodes at staff ends
philology_art_concordance: Authentic Kyivan Recension; Yas. № 38 (Варшава, БН, 12052 III)

incipit_diplomatic: Руцѣ распростеръ Даніилъ... левовъ зіянія во рвѣ загради огненную же силу угасиша добродетелию препоясавшеся иже благочестія любители отроци поюще: благословите вся дѣла Господня Господа
incipit_english: Daniel, stretching out his hands, stopped the mouths of lions in the pit; and the youths, lovers of piety, girded with virtue, quenched the power of fire, singing: Bless the Lord, all ye works of the Lord!
musical_paleography: Kyivan square notation (київська нота); Scribe Hand A (fine Ukrainian semi-uncial півустав); 12 rastrum-ruled staves per page; C-clef on 3rd/2nd line; Custodes at staff ends
philology_art_concordance: Authentic Kyivan Recension; Yas. № 38 (Варшава, БН, 12052 III)

incipit_diplomatic: Ѡтроки благочестивыя во пещи рожество Богородично спасло есть... тогда образуемо нынѣ же дѣйствуемо вселенную всю созываетъ пѣти: Господа пойте...
incipit_english: The birth of the Theotokos saved the pious youths in the furnace... then prefigured, but now realized, it summons the whole universe to sing: Praise ye the Lord...
musical_paleography: Kyivan square notation (київська нота); Scribe Hand A (fine Ukrainian semi-uncial півустав); 12 rastrum-ruled staves per page; C-clef on 3rd/2nd line; Custodes at staff ends
philology_art_concordance: Authentic Kyivan Recension; Yas. № 38 (Варшава, БН, 12052 III)

incipit_diplomatic: Избавителю всѣхъ... посреде пламене... оросившія отроки... научи пѣти вся дѣла благословите Господа
incipit_english: Deliverer of all... in the midst of flame... Who didst bedew the youths... teach us to sing: All ye works, bless the Lord!
musical_paleography: Kyivan square notation (київська нота); Scribe Hand A (fine Ukrainian semi-uncial півустав); 12 rastrum-ruled staves per page; C-clef on 3rd/2nd line; Custodes at staff ends
philology_art_concordance: Authentic Kyivan Recension; Yas. № 38 (Варшава, БН, 12052 III)

incipit_diplomatic: Веселися Іерусалиме торжествуйте любящіи Сіона... приде бо цѣлитель... благословите вся дѣла Господня Господа
incipit_english: Rejoice, O Jerusalem! Celebrate, ye that love Zion... for the Healer has come... bless the Lord, all ye works of the Lord!
musical_paleography: Kyivan square notation (київська нота); Scribe Hand A (fine Ukrainian semi-uncial півустав); 12 rastrum-ruled staves per page; C-clef on 3rd/2nd line; Custodes at staff ends
philology_art_concordance: Authentic Kyivan Recension; Yas. № 38 (Варшава, БН, 12052 III)

incipit_diplomatic: Ѡни пламени престояще ти херувими, серафими Господа...
incipit_english: Those standing before the flame, Cherubim and Seraphim, praise the Lord...
musical_paleography: Kyivan square notation (київська нота); Scribe Hand A (fine Ukrainian semi-uncial півустав); 12 rastrum-ruled staves per page; C-clef on 3rd/2nd line; Custodes at staff ends
philology_art_concordance: Authentic Kyivan Recension; Yas. № 38 (Варшава, БН, 12052 III)

incipit_diplomatic: Во Вавилонѣ отроци божественною опаляеми ревностію мучителя и пламене прещеніе мужески поправше и посредѣ зѣлнаго... во пещи прохлажаеми пояху: благословите вся дѣла Господня Господа
incipit_english: In Babylon, the youths, inflamed with divine zeal, courageously trampled upon the threat of the tyrant and the flame, and refreshed in the midst of the furnace, sang: Bless the Lord, all ye works of the Lord!
musical_paleography: Kyivan square notation (київська нота); Scribe Hand A (fine Ukrainian semi-uncial півустав); 12 rastrum-ruled staves per page; C-clef on 3rd/2nd line; Custodes at staff ends
philology_art_concordance: Authentic Kyivan Recension; Yas. № 38 (Варшава, БН, 12052 III)

incipit_diplomatic: Радующеся по осуженію мучительску отроци... Боговѣрніи послуживше казни помугу... на огнь дерзнувша...
incipit_english: Rejoicing after the tyrant's condemnation, the faithful youths dared to brave the fire...
musical_paleography: Kyivan square notation (київська нота); Scribe Hand A (fine Ukrainian semi-uncial півустав); 12 rastrum-ruled staves per page; C-clef on 3rd/2nd line; Custodes at staff ends
philology_art_concordance: Authentic Kyivan Recension; Yas. № 38 (Варшава, БН, 12052 III)

incipit_diplomatic: Рѣвность узрѣвши и прохлаждающися... пламень... благословите единаго Спаса и Содѣтеля яко благателя...
incipit_english: Beholding zeal and being refreshed... bless the one Savior and Creator as Benefactor...
musical_paleography: Kyivan square notation (київська нота); Scribe Hand A (fine Ukrainian semi-uncial півустав); 12 rastrum-ruled staves per page; C-clef on 3rd/2nd line; Custodes at staff ends
philology_art_concordance: Authentic Kyivan Recension; Yas. № 38 (Варшава, БН, 12052 III)

incipit_diplomatic: Услышаша отроковици девическій плачь... рече: убога прини... совлѣцы на совлѣче... укрепленный... богатою Твоею...
incipit_english: The maidens heard the virgin's lament...
musical_paleography: Kyivan square notation (київська нота); Scribe Hand A (fine Ukrainian semi-uncial півустав); 12 rastrum-ruled staves per page; C-clef on 3rd/2nd line; Custodes at staff ends
philology_art_concordance: Authentic Kyivan Recension; Yas. № 38 (Варшава, БН, 12052 III)

incipit_diplomatic: Царя Христа Бога егоже исповѣдаша плененніи отроцы во пещи глаголюще гласомъ великимъ вся дѣла хвалите и превозносите его во вѣки
incipit_english: Christ the King and God, Whom the captive youths confessed in the furnace, shouting with a loud voice: All ye works, praise and supreme exalt Him unto all ages!
musical_paleography: Kyivan square notation (київська нота); Scribe Hand A (fine Ukrainian semi-uncial півустав); 12 rastrum-ruled staves per page; C-clef on 3rd/2nd line; Custodes at staff ends
philology_art_concordance: Authentic Kyivan Recension; Yas. № 38 (Варшава, БН, 12052 III)

incipit_diplomatic: Вся дѣла божія и вся тварь благословите Господа преподобніи и смиренніи сердцемъ пойте его... и превозносите его во вѣки
incipit_reconstructed: Вся дѣла божія и вся тварь благословите
incipit_english: All works of God and all creation, bless the Lord; ye holy and humble of heart, sing unto Him and supreme exalt Him unto all ages!
musical_paleography: Kyivan square notation (київська нота); Scribe Hand A (fine Ukrainian semi-uncial півустав); 12 rastrum-ruled staves per page; C-clef on 3rd/2nd line; Custodes at staff ends
philology_art_concordance: Authentic Kyivan Recension; Yas. № 38 (Варшава, БН, 12052 III)

incipit_diplomatic: Всяческа Владыко премудростію состави...
incipit_english: All things, O Master, hast Thou fashioned with wisdom...
musical_paleography: Kyivan square notation (київська нота); Scribe Hand A (fine Ukrainian semi-uncial півустав); 12 rastrum-ruled staves per page; C-clef on 3rd/2nd line; Custodes at staff ends
philology_art_concordance: Authentic Kyivan Recension; Yas. № 38 (Варшава, БН, 12052 III)

incipit_diplomatic: Рапятаго плотію на крестѣ и показавшаго намъ оружіе на спасеніе отроцы превозносите Христа Бога нашего по вся вѣки
incipit_english: Him Who was crucified in the flesh upon the Cross, and showed us a weapon unto salvation, O youths, supreme exalt Christ our God unto all ages!
musical_paleography: Kyivan square notation (київська нота); Scribe Hand A (fine Ukrainian semi-uncial півустав); 12 rastrum-ruled staves per page; C-clef on 3rd/2nd line; Custodes at staff ends
philology_art_concordance: Authentic Kyivan Recension; Yas. № 38 (Варшава, БН, 12052 III)

incipit_diplomatic: Земля и вся яже на ней моря и источницы небеса небесъ... человѣчестіи и іереи благословите Господа и превозносите его во вѣки
incipit_reconstructed: Земля и вся яже на ней моря и источницы
incipit_english: Earth and all things therein, seas and fountains, heavens of heavens... sons of men and priests, bless the Lord and supreme exalt Him unto all ages!
musical_paleography: Kyivan square notation (київська нота); Scribe Hand A (fine Ukrainian semi-uncial півустав); 12 rastrum-ruled staves per page; C-clef on 3rd/2nd line; Custodes at staff ends
philology_art_concordance: Authentic Kyivan Recension; Yas. № 38 (Варшава, БН, 12052 III)

incipit_diplomatic: Всяческая нося...
incipit_english: Upholding all things...
musical_paleography: Kyivan square notation (київська нота); Scribe Hand A (fine Ukrainian semi-uncial півустав); 12 rastrum-ruled staves per page; C-clef on 3rd/2nd line; Custodes at staff ends
philology_art_concordance: Authentic Kyivan Recension; Yas. № 38 (Варшава, БН, 12052 III)

incipit_diplomatic: Иже во образѣ ангела явльшагося во пещи огненнѣй... пѣснословяще Христа Бога нашего пойте дѣла... спасеніи благословите людіе и превозносите его во вѣки
incipit_english: He Who appeared in the likeness of an angel in the fiery furnace... praising Christ our God, sing, ye works... bless Him, ye peoples, and supreme exalt Him unto all ages!
musical_paleography: Kyivan square notation (київська нота); Scribe Hand A (fine Ukrainian semi-uncial півустав); 12 rastrum-ruled staves per page; C-clef on 3rd/2nd line; Custodes at staff ends
philology_art_concordance: Authentic Kyivan Recension; Yas. № 38 (Варшава, БН, 12052 III)

incipit_diplomatic: Камень нерукосѣчный ѿ несѣкомыя горы Тебе Дѣвице краеугольный отсѣчеся Христос совокупи растоящаяся естества... веселящеся Тя Богородице величаемъ
incipit_english: A cornerstone was cut without hands from Thee, O virgin uncut mountain: Christ, Who united the separated natures... rejoicing, we magnify Thee, O Theotokos!
musical_paleography: Kyivan square notation (київська нота); Scribe Hand A (fine Ukrainian semi-uncial півустав); 12 rastrum-ruled staves per page; C-clef on 3rd/2nd line; Custodes at staff ends
philology_art_concordance: Authentic Kyivan Recension; Yas. № 38 (Варшава, БН, 12052 III)

incipit_diplomatic: Всякъ земнородный да возиграется духомъ просвѣщаемъ... да ликовствуютъ же безплотныхъ умовъ естество почитая... и радуйся преблаженная Богородице чистая приснодѣво
incipit_english: Let every earthborn mortal leap for joy, enlightened in spirit... and let the nature of bodiless minds celebrate, honoring the sacred festival... Rejoice, all-blessed Theotokos, pure Ever-Virgin!
musical_paleography: Kyivan square notation (київська нота); Scribe Hand A (fine Ukrainian semi-uncial півустав); 12 rastrum-ruled staves per page; C-clef on 3rd/2nd line; Custodes at staff ends
philology_art_concordance: Authentic Kyivan Recension; Yas. № 38 (Варшава, БН, 12052 III)

incipit_diplomatic: Богосподинъ... сѣни составити... придите радующеся придите повеличати Христа с палями и вѣтвьми пѣсньми вѣрніи благословящи Господа Спаса нашего
incipit_english: God the Lord... come, rejoicing, come to magnify Christ with palms and branches, singing with faithful songs, blessing the Lord our Savior!
musical_paleography: Kyivan square notation (київська нота); Scribe Hand A (fine Ukrainian semi-uncial півустав); 12 rastrum-ruled staves per page; C-clef on 3rd/2nd line; Custodes at staff ends
philology_art_concordance: Authentic Kyivan Recension; Yas. № 38 (Варшава, БН, 12052 III)

incipit_diplomatic: Радуйся Царице матерняя... всяко бо добро...
incipit_english: Rejoice, O Queen, motherly pride... for every good...
musical_paleography: Kyivan square notation (київська нота); Scribe Hand A (fine Ukrainian semi-uncial півустав); 12 rastrum-ruled staves per page; C-clef on 3rd/2nd line; Custodes at staff ends
philology_art_concordance: Authentic Kyivan Recension; Yas. № 38 (Варшава, БН, 12052 III)

incipit_diplomatic: Рожество ти нетлѣнно явися Богъ из боку Твоею пройде плотоносецъ явися на земли и со человѣки пожи... Тя Богородице пѣсньми величаемъ
incipit_english: Thy giving of birth was shown to be incorrupt: God came forth from Thy womb, appeared on earth bearing flesh, and lived among men... Thee, O Theotokos, we magnify in song!
musical_paleography: Kyivan square notation (київська нота); Scribe Hand A (fine Ukrainian semi-uncial півустав); 12 rastrum-ruled staves per page; C-clef on 3rd/2nd line; Custodes at staff ends
philology_art_concordance: Authentic Kyivan Recension; Yas. № 38 (Варшава, БН, 12052 III)

incipit_diplomatic: Чюдна божія пріимата... пожеже бывша... иже бо ис тебе воплотися да милосердіемъ спасеть тя яко...
incipit_english: Wondrous are the vessels of God... for He Who was incarnate of Thee, that by mercy He might save...
musical_paleography: Kyivan square notation (київська нота); Scribe Hand A (fine Ukrainian semi-uncial півустав); 12 rastrum-ruled staves per page; C-clef on 3rd/2nd line; Custodes at staff ends
philology_art_concordance: Authentic Kyivan Recension; Yas. № 38 (Варшава, БН, 12052 III)

incipit_diplomatic: Яко одушевленному Божію кивоту да николиже коснется рука скверныхъ уста же вѣрныхъ Богородицѣ немолчно гласъ ангела воспѣвающе радостію вопіюще: радуйся обрадованная Господь с тобою
incipit_english: As the living Ark of God, let no hand of the profane touch Thee, but let the lips of the faithful unceasingly chanting the Angel's greeting cry out with joy: Rejoice, thou full of grace, the Lord is with thee!
musical_paleography: Kyivan square notation (київська нота); Scribe Hand A (fine Ukrainian semi-uncial півустав); 12 rastrum-ruled staves per page; C-clef on 3rd/2nd line; Custodes at staff ends
philology_art_concordance: Authentic Kyivan Recension; Yas. № 38 (Варшава, БН, 12052 III)

incipit_diplomatic: Сѣнь убо немощствующаго закона прейде... ты же Дѣво Богородице прозябеніе присноживотнаго... мирови благословеніе процвила еси пѣсньми Тя величаемъ
incipit_english: The shadow of the failing Law hath passed away... but Thou, O Virgin Theotokos, offshoot of life eternal, hast blossomed forth blessing unto the world: in songs we magnify Thee!
musical_paleography: Kyivan square notation (київська нота); Scribe Hand A (fine Ukrainian semi-uncial півустав); 12 rastrum-ruled staves per page; C-clef on 3rd/2nd line; Custodes at staff ends
philology_art_concordance: Authentic Kyivan Recension; Yas. № 38 (Варшава, БН, 12052 III)

incipit_diplomatic: Сокруши мя... человѣколюбче...
incipit_english: Crushed am I... O Lover of mankind...
musical_paleography: Kyivan square notation (київська нота); Scribe Hand A (fine Ukrainian semi-uncial півустав); 12 rastrum-ruled staves per page; C-clef on 3rd/2nd line; Custodes at staff ends
philology_art_concordance: Pre-Nikonian Authentic Kyivan Recension; Yas. № 38 (Варшава, БН, 12052 III)

incipit_diplomatic: Ꙗко сотвори мнѣ величіе сильный и свято имя его...
incipit_english: For He that is mighty hath done to me great things, and holy is His name...
musical_paleography: Kyivan square notation (київська нота); Scribe Hand A (fine Ukrainian semi-uncial півустав); 12 rastrum-ruled staves per page; C-clef on 3rd/2nd line; Custodes at staff ends
philology_art_concordance: Authentic Kyivan Recension; Yas. № 38 (Варшава, БН, 12052 III)

incipit_diplomatic: Ѡтъ земныхъ рожденныхъ кто слыша таковая...
incipit_reconstructed: От земных рожденных кто слыша таковая
incipit_english: Who of those born of earth hath heard such things...
musical_paleography: Kyivan square notation (київська нота); Scribe Hand A (fine Ukrainian semi-uncial півустав); 12 rastrum-ruled staves per page; C-clef on 3rd/2nd line; Custodes at staff ends
philology_art_concordance: Authentic Kyivan Recension; Yas. № 38 (Варшава, БН, 12052 III)

incipit_diplomatic: Мати єси на горѣ... сыне божій...
incipit_reconstructed: Мати єси на горѣ Сыне Божій
incipit_english: Thou art a Mother on the mountain, O Son of God...
musical_paleography: Kyivan square notation (київська нота); Scribe Hand A (fine Ukrainian semi-uncial півустав); 12 rastrum-ruled staves per page; C-clef on 3rd/2nd line; Custodes at staff ends
philology_art_concordance: Authentic Kyivan Recension; Yas. № 38 (Варшава, БН, 12052 III)

incipit_diplomatic: Тайно повѣдаетъ пророкомъ духовнымъ...
incipit_english: In mystery it declareth unto the spiritual prophets...
musical_paleography: Kyivan square notation (київська нота); Scribe Hand A (fine Ukrainian semi-uncial півустав); 12 rastrum-ruled staves per page; C-clef on 3rd/2nd line; Custodes at staff ends
philology_art_concordance: Authentic Kyivan Recension; Yas. № 38 (Варшава, БН, 12052 III)

incipit_diplomatic: Такрасно неискусному... во хваленія...
incipit_english: Most fair unto the unskilled...
musical_paleography: Kyivan square notation (київська нота); Scribe Hand A (fine Ukrainian semi-uncial півустав); 12 rastrum-ruled staves per page; C-clef on 3rd/2nd line; Custodes at staff ends
philology_art_concordance: Authentic Kyivan Recension; Yas. № 38 (Варшава, БН, 12052 III)

incipit_diplomatic: Совѣтъ превѣчныи откровенъ бысть...
incipit_english: The pre-eternal counsel hath been revealed...
musical_paleography: Kyivan square notation (київська нота); Scribe Hand A (fine Ukrainian semi-uncial півустав); 12 rastrum-ruled staves per page; C-clef on 3rd/2nd line; Custodes at staff ends
philology_art_concordance: Authentic Kyivan Recension; Yas. № 38 (Варшава, БН, 12052 III)

incipit_english: Unto those who greatly love Thee, O Christ... light of the night... wherefore rising early from the night we ask mercy...
musical_paleography: Kyivan square notation (київська нота); Scribe Hand A (fine Ukrainian semi-uncial півустав); 12 rastrum-ruled staves per page; C-clef on 3rd/2nd line; Custodes at staff ends
philology_art_concordance: Authentic Kyivan Recension; Yas. № 38 (Варшава, БН, 12052 III)

incipit_diplomatic: Ѡсиявъ свѣтъ всему миру просвѣти ны господи заповѣдми своими...
incipit_english: Having made light to shine upon the whole world, enlighten us, O Lord, by Thy commandments...
musical_paleography: Kyivan square notation (київська нота); Scribe Hand A (fine Ukrainian semi-uncial півустав); 12 rastrum-ruled staves per page; C-clef on 3rd/2nd line; Custodes at staff ends
philology_art_concordance: Authentic Kyivan Recension; Yas. № 38 (Варшава, БН, 12052 III)

incipit_diplomatic: Ѡтъ нощи утренююще человѣколюбче молимся подаждь намъ мирное житіе...
incipit_english: Early from the night waking unto Thee, O Lover of mankind, we pray: grant us a peaceful life...
musical_paleography: Kyivan square notation (київська нота); Scribe Hand A (fine Ukrainian semi-uncial півустав); 12 rastrum-ruled staves per page; C-clef on 3rd/2nd line; Custodes at staff ends
philology_art_concordance: Pre-Nikonian Authentic Kyivan Recension; Yas. № 38 (Варшава, БН, 12052 III)

incipit_diplomatic: Союзомъ любве связуеми апостоли владычествующему всѣми себѣ христу возложивше...
incipit_english: Bound by the bond of love, the Apostles, dedicating themselves to Christ who ruleth over all...
musical_paleography: Kyivan square notation (київська нота); Scribe Hand A (fine Ukrainian semi-uncial півустав); 12 rastrum-ruled staves per page; C-clef on 3rd/2nd line; Custodes at staff ends
philology_art_concordance: Authentic Kyivan Recension; Yas. № 38 (Варшава, БН, 12052 III)

incipit_diplomatic: Къ тебѣ утренюю милосердія ради себе истощившему непремѣнно даже и до страсти...
incipit_reconstructed: К тебѣ утренюю милосердія ради Себе
incipit_english: Unto Thee do I rise early from the night, Who through tender mercy didst empty Thyself without change even unto the Passion...
musical_paleography: Kyivan square notation (київська нота); Scribe Hand A (fine Ukrainian semi-uncial півустав); 12 rastrum-ruled staves per page; C-clef on 3rd/2nd line; Custodes at staff ends
philology_art_concordance: Authentic Kyivan Recension; Yas. № 38 (Варшава, БН, 12052 III)

incipit_diplomatic: Богоявленія твоего христе къ намъ милостивно бывшаго исаіа свѣтъ видѣвъ невечерній...
incipit_reconstructed: Богоявленія Твоего Христе к нам милостивно
incipit_english: Isaiah, having seen the unwaning light of Thy divine manifestation mercifully made unto us, O Christ...
musical_paleography: Kyivan square notation (київська нота); Scribe Hand A (fine Ukrainian semi-uncial півустав); 12 rastrum-ruled staves per page; C-clef on 3rd/2nd line; Custodes at staff ends
philology_art_concordance: Authentic Kyivan Recension; Yas. № 38 (Варшава, БН, 12052 III)

incipit_diplomatic: Житейское море воздвизаемое зря напастей бурею къ тихому пристанищу твоему притекъ вопію ти: возведи от тли животъ мои многомилостиве.
incipit_english: Beholding the sea of life surging with the storm of temptations, and fleeing to Thy calm haven, I cry unto Thee: Lead up my life from corruption, O Greatly Merciful One...
musical_paleography: Kyivan square notation (київська нота); Scribe Hand A (fine Ukrainian semi-uncial півустав); 12 rastrum-ruled staves per page; C-clef on 3rd/2nd line; Custodes at staff ends
philology_art_concordance: Authentic Kyivan Recension; Yas. № 38 (Варшава, БН, 12052 III)

incipit_diplomatic: Бездна послѣдняя грѣховъ обыде мя и волненія не терпя яко іона владыцѣ вопію ти: от тли мя возведи.
incipit_english: The uttermost deep of sins hath encompassed me, and unable to endure the surge, like Jonah I cry unto the Master: Lead me up from corruption...
liturgical_title: Sunday of the Paralytic Canon Irmos Ode 6 (Tone 3)
musical_paleography: Kyivan square notation (київська нота); Scribe Hand A (fine Ukrainian semi-uncial півустав); 12 rastrum-ruled staves per page; C-clef on 3rd/2nd line; Custodes at staff ends
philology_art_concordance: Authentic Kyivan Recension; Yas. № 38 (Варшава, БН, 12052 III)

incipit_diplomatic: Возопихъ всѣмъ сердцемъ моимъ къ щедрому богу и услыша мя от ада преисподняго и возведе от тли животъ мои.
incipit_reconstructed: Возопих всѣм сердцем моим к щедрому Богу
incipit_english: I cried with my whole heart unto the bountiful God, and He heard me from the nethermost hades, and led up my life from corruption...
liturgical_title: Great Canon of St. Andrew of Crete Ode 6
musical_paleography: Kyivan square notation (київська нота); Scribe Hand A (fine Ukrainian semi-uncial півустав); 12 rastrum-ruled staves per page; C-clef on 3rd/2nd line; Custodes at staff ends
philology_art_concordance: Authentic Kyivan Recension; Yas. № 38 (Варшава, БН, 12052 III)

incipit_diplomatic: Начальникъ бывъ спаситель нашъ и избавитель... вопіемъ ти: от тли мя возведи.
incipit_reconstructed: Начальник быв Спаситель наш и Избавитель
incipit_english: Having become the Author, our Savior and Redeemer... we cry unto Thee: Lead me up from corruption...
musical_paleography: Kyivan square notation (київська нота); Scribe Hand A (fine Ukrainian semi-uncial півустав); 12 rastrum-ruled staves per page; C-clef on 3rd/2nd line; Custodes at staff ends
philology_art_concordance: Authentic Kyivan Recension; Yas. № 38 (Варшава, БН, 12052 III)

incipit_diplomatic: Нынѣ поможе десница твоя господи... от тли мя возведи христе боже нашъ.
incipit_english: Now Thy right hand hath helped, O Lord... lead me up from corruption, O Christ our God...
musical_paleography: Kyivan square notation (київська нота); Scribe Hand A (fine Ukrainian semi-uncial півустав); 12 rastrum-ruled staves per page; C-clef on 3rd/2nd line; Custodes at staff ends
philology_art_concordance: Authentic Kyivan Recension; Yas. № 38 (Варшава, БН, 12052 III)

incipit_diplomatic: Исполнися скорбію душа моя и животъ мои аду приближися и молюся яко іона: от тли боже возведи мя.
incipit_english: My soul is full of troubles, and my life draweth nigh unto hades, and I pray like Jonah: O God, lead me up from corruption...
musical_paleography: Kyivan square notation (київська нота); Scribe Hand A (fine Ukrainian semi-uncial півустав); 12 rastrum-ruled staves per page; C-clef on 3rd/2nd line; Custodes at staff ends
philology_art_concordance: Authentic Kyivan Recension; Yas. № 38 (Варшава, БН, 12052 III)

incipit_diplomatic: Возопихъ господи слыши мя во скорби моей и избави мя от тли животъ мои человѣколюбче.
incipit_reconstructed: Возопих Господи слыши мя во скорби моей
incipit_english: I cried, O Lord, hear me in mine affliction, and deliver my life from corruption, O Lover of mankind...
musical_paleography: Kyivan square notation (київська нота); Scribe Hand A (fine Ukrainian semi-uncial півустав); 12 rastrum-ruled staves per page; C-clef on 3rd/2nd line; Custodes at staff ends
philology_art_concordance: Authentic Kyivan Recension; Yas. № 38 (Варшава, БН, 12052 III)

incipit_diplomatic: Младоумны убо яшася во глубину греховную... яко іона от кита вопію ти: от тли мя возведи.
incipit_reconstructed: Младоумны убо яшася во глубину греховную
incipit_english: The childish-minded were seized into the depths of sin... like Jonah from the sea monster I cry unto Thee: lead me up from corruption...
musical_paleography: Kyivan square notation (київська нота); Scribe Hand A (fine Ukrainian semi-uncial півустав); 12 rastrum-ruled staves per page; C-clef on 3rd/2nd line; Custodes at staff ends
philology_art_concordance: Authentic Kyivan Recension; Yas. № 38 (Варшава, БН, 12052 III)

incipit_diplomatic: Ѡтроцы въ пещи пламенныя огнь поправше пояху: благословенъ еси господи боже отецъ нашихъ.
incipit_english: The children in the fiery furnace, trampling upon the flame, sang: Blessed art Thou, O Lord God of our fathers...
musical_paleography: Kyivan square notation (київська нота); Scribe Hand A (fine Ukrainian semi-uncial півустав); 12 rastrum-ruled staves per page; C-clef on 3rd/2nd line; Custodes at staff ends
philology_art_concordance: Authentic Kyivan Recension; Yas. № 38 (Варшава, БН, 12052 III)

incipit_diplomatic: Неизреченное чюдо въ пещи избави преподобныя отроки изъ пламене: поимъ благословенъ еси господи боже отецъ нашихъ.
incipit_reconstructed: Неизреченное чудо в пещи избави преподобныя отроки
incipit_english: An ineffable wonder in the furnace delivered the holy youths from the flame: let us sing: Blessed art Thou, O Lord God of our fathers...
musical_paleography: Kyivan square notation (київська нота); Scribe Hand A (fine Ukrainian semi-uncial півустав); 12 rastrum-ruled staves per page; C-clef on 3rd/2nd line; Custodes at staff ends
philology_art_concordance: Authentic Kyivan Recension; Yas. № 38 (Варшава, БН, 12052 III)

incipit_diplomatic: Согрѣшихомъ беззаконновахомъ неправдовахомъ предъ тобою, ниже соблюдохомъ, ниже сотворихомъ, якоже заповѣдалъ еси намъ; но не предаждь насъ до конца, отцевъ боже.
incipit_english: We have sinned, we have transgressed, we have done unrighteously before Thee, neither have we kept nor done as Thou hast commanded us; but deliver us not up utterly, O God of the fathers...
musical_paleography: Kyivan square notation (київська нота); Scribe Hand A (fine Ukrainian semi-uncial півустав); 12 rastrum-ruled staves per page; C-clef on 3rd/2nd line; Custodes at staff ends
philology_art_concordance: Authentic Kyivan Recension; Yas. № 38 (Варшава, БН, 12052 III)

incipit_diplomatic: Спасити хотя тварь свою отроцы хваляще пояху: благословенъ еси господи боже отецъ нашихъ.
incipit_english: Desiring to save Thy creation, the youths praising sang: Blessed art Thou, O Lord God of our fathers...
musical_paleography: Kyivan square notation (київська нота); Scribe Hand A (fine Ukrainian semi-uncial півустав); 12 rastrum-ruled staves per page; C-clef on 3rd/2nd line; Custodes at staff ends
philology_art_concordance: Authentic Kyivan Recension; Yas. № 38 (Варшава, БН, 12052 III)

incipit_diplomatic: Пламена свети росу преложивъ христосъ богъ отроки спасе: благословенъ еси господи боже отецъ нашихъ.
incipit_english: Turning the radiant flame into dew, Christ God saved the youths: Blessed art Thou, O Lord God of our fathers...
musical_paleography: Kyivan square notation (київська нота); Scribe Hand A (fine Ukrainian semi-uncial півустав); 12 rastrum-ruled staves per page; C-clef on 3rd/2nd line; Custodes at staff ends
philology_art_concordance: Authentic Kyivan Recension; Yas. № 38 (Варшава, БН, 12052 III)

incipit_diplomatic: Ужаснися бояся небо и да подвижатся основания земли, се бо в мертвыхъ вмѣняется в вышнихъ живыи и во гробъ малъ страннопріемлется: егоже отроцы благословите, священницы воспойте, людіе превозносите во вся вѣки.
incipit_english: Be astonished, O heaven, with fear, and let the foundations of the earth be shaken; for lo, He that dwelleth in the highest is numbered among the dead and is lodged in a small tomb; whom, ye children, bless, ye priests, praise, and people, exalt above all forever...
musical_paleography: Kyivan square notation (київська нота); Scribe Hand A (fine Ukrainian semi-uncial півустав); 12 rastrum-ruled staves per page; C-clef on 3rd/2nd line; Custodes at staff ends
philology_art_concordance: Authentic Kyivan Recension; Yas. № 38 (Варшава, БН, 12052 III)

incipit_diplomatic: По закону отцевъ блаженніи отроци во вавилонѣ бѣдствовавше царева повелѣнія преобидѣвше...
incipit_english: According to the law of the fathers, the blessed youths being in danger in Babylon, scorning the decree of the king...
musical_paleography: Kyivan square notation (київська нота); Scribe Hand A (fine Ukrainian semi-uncial півустав); 12 rastrum-ruled staves per page; C-clef on 3rd/2nd line; Custodes at staff ends
philology_art_concordance: Authentic Kyivan Recension; Yas. № 38 (Варшава, БН, 12052 III)

incipit_diplomatic: Светіи отроци во пещи по паляще херувимомъ уподобишася троичную пѣснь воспѣвающе: благословите вся дѣла господня господа и превозносите его во вся вѣки.
incipit_reconstructed: Святіи отроцы в пещи попаляющей херувимом уподобишася
incipit_english: The holy youths in the burning furnace likened unto the Cherubim, singing the Thrice-Holy hymn: Bless the Lord, all ye works of the Lord, and exalt Him above all forever...
musical_paleography: Kyivan square notation (київська нота); Scribe Hand A (fine Ukrainian semi-uncial півустав); 12 rastrum-ruled staves per page; C-clef on 3rd/2nd line; Custodes at staff ends
philology_art_concordance: Authentic Kyivan Recension; Yas. № 38 (Варшава, БН, 12052 III)

incipit_diplomatic: Егоже вои небесніи славятъ и трепещутъ херувими и серафими...
incipit_english: Him Whom the heavenly hosts glorify, and before Whom the Cherubim and Seraphim tremble...
musical_paleography: Kyivan square notation (київська нота); Scribe Hand A (fine Ukrainian semi-uncial півустав); 12 rastrum-ruled staves per page; C-clef on 3rd/2nd line; Custodes at staff ends
philology_art_concordance: Authentic Kyivan Recension; Yas. № 38 (Варшава, БН, 12052 III)

incipit_diplomatic: Тѣлу злочестивому навуходоносорови образъ златый на поли деирѣ поставленъ отроци божественніи преобидѣвше: благословите вся дѣла господа и превозносите его во вся вѣки.
incipit_english: Scorning the golden image set up on the plain of Dura by the ungodly body of Nebuchadnezzar, the divine youths sang: Bless the Lord, all ye works of the Lord, and exalt Him above all forever...
musical_paleography: Kyivan square notation (київська нота); Scribe Hand A (fine Ukrainian semi-uncial півустав); 12 rastrum-ruled staves per page; C-clef on 3rd/2nd line; Custodes at staff ends
philology_art_concordance: Authentic Kyivan Recension; Yas. № 38 (Варшава, БН, 12052 III)

incipit_diplomatic: Жало смерти сокрушивъ христе во крестѣ твоемъ, животъ мирови даровалъ еси: благословите вся дѣла господа и превозносите его во вѣки.
incipit_reconstructed: Жало смерти сокрушив Христе во крестѣ Твоем
incipit_english: Having broken the sting of death by Thy Cross, O Christ, Thou hast bestowed life upon the world: Bless the Lord, all ye works, and exalt Him forever...
musical_paleography: Kyivan square notation (київська нота); Scribe Hand A (fine Ukrainian semi-uncial півустав); 12 rastrum-ruled staves per page; C-clef on 3rd/2nd line; Custodes at staff ends
philology_art_concordance: Authentic Kyivan Recension; Yas. № 38 (Варшава, БН, 12052 III)

incipit_diplomatic: Светіи трие отроцы во пещи спасеніи: да благословитъ тварь вся господа и превозноситъ во вся вѣки.
incipit_reconstructed: Святіи тріе отроцы в пещи спасеніи
incipit_english: The holy three youths saved in the furnace: let all creation bless the Lord and exalt Him above all forever...
musical_paleography: Kyivan square notation (київська нота); Scribe Hand A (fine Ukrainian semi-uncial півустав); 12 rastrum-ruled staves per page; C-clef on 3rd/2nd line; Custodes at staff ends
philology_art_concordance: Authentic Kyivan Recension; Yas. № 38 (Варшава, БН, 12052 III)

incipit_diplomatic: Прообрази раждающую тя огнь не вредими сохраниша отроки: вся тварь благословитъ господа и превозноситъ его во вѣки.
incipit_reconstructed: Прообрази раждающую Тя огнь не вредими сохраниша
incipit_english: Prefiguring Her that bare Thee, the fire preserved the youths unharmed: let all creation bless the Lord and exalt Him forever...
musical_paleography: Kyivan square notation (київська нота); Scribe Hand A (fine Ukrainian semi-uncial півустав); 12 rastrum-ruled staves per page; C-clef on 3rd/2nd line; Custodes at staff ends
philology_art_concordance: Authentic Kyivan Recension; Yas. № 38 (Варшава, БН, 12052 III)

incipit_diplomatic: Бога от отца отроцы пойте и превозносите во вся вѣки.
incipit_english: Praise God of the Father, ye youths, and exalt Him above all forever...
musical_paleography: Kyivan square notation (київська нота); Scribe Hand A (fine Ukrainian semi-uncial півустав); 12 rastrum-ruled staves per page; C-clef on 3rd/2nd line; Custodes at staff ends
philology_art_concordance: Authentic Kyivan Recension; Yas. № 38 (Варшава, БН, 12052 III)

incipit_diplomatic: Бога человѣкомъ не возможно видѣти...
incipit_english: It is not possible for men to see God, upon Whom the ranks of angels dare not gaze...
musical_paleography: Kyivan square notation (київська нота); Scribe Hand A (fine Ukrainian semi-uncial півустав); 12 rastrum-ruled staves per page; C-clef on 3rd/2nd line; Custodes at staff ends
philology_art_concordance: Authentic Kyivan Recension; Yas. № 38 (Варшава, БН, 12052 III)

incipit_diplomatic: Не ридаи мене мати зрящи во гробѣ егоже во чревѣ без сѣмене зачала єси сына: востану бо и прославлюся, и вознесу со славою непрестанно яко богъ вѣрою и любовію тя величающыя.
incipit_reconstructed: Не рыдай Мене Мати зрящи во гробѣ
incipit_english: Weep not for Me, O Mother, beholding in the tomb the Son Whom thou didst conceive in thy womb without seed; for I shall arise and be glorified...
musical_paleography: Kyivan square notation (київська нота); Scribe Hand A (fine Ukrainian semi-uncial півустав); 12 rastrum-ruled staves per page; C-clef on 3rd/2nd line; Custodes at staff ends
philology_art_concordance: Authentic Kyivan Recension; Yas. № 38 (Варшава, БН, 12052 III)

incipit_diplomatic: Странствіа владычня и безсмер[тныя] тра[пезы]...
incipit_english: Come, ye faithful, let us enjoy the Master's hospitality and the immortal table on the high place with elevated minds...
musical_paleography: Kyivan square notation (київська нота); Scribe Hand A (fine Ukrainian semi-uncial півустав); 12 rastrum-ruled staves per page; C-clef on 3rd/2nd line; Custodes at staff ends
philology_art_concordance: Authentic Kyivan Recension; Yas. № 38 (Варшава, БН, 12052 III)

incipit_diplomatic: Без сѣмене зачатіа рожденіе не сказанно матере безмужныа: нетлѣнно прижитіе божіе бо рожденіе обновляетъ естество твое, тѣмъ тя вси роди богоневѣстную матере правовѣрно величаемъ.
incipit_english: The conception is without seed, the birth ineffable of a mother who knew no man: for the birth of God reneweth nature, wherefore all generations orthodoxly magnify thee, the Bride of God...
musical_paleography: Kyivan square notation (київська нота); Scribe Hand A (fine Ukrainian semi-uncial півустав); 12 rastrum-ruled staves per page; C-clef on 3rd/2nd line; Custodes at staff ends
philology_art_concordance: Authentic Kyivan Recension; Yas. № 38 (Варшава, БН, 12052 III)

incipit_diplomatic: Честнѣйшую херувимъ и славнѣйшую без сравненія серафимъ без истлѣнія бога слова рождьшую сущую богородицу тя величаемъ.
incipit_reconstructed: Честнѣйшую херувим и славнѣйшую без сравненія серафим
incipit_english: More honorable than the Cherubim, and beyond compare more glorious than the Seraphim, thee who without defilement barest God the Word, true Theotokos, we magnify...
musical_paleography: Kyivan square notation (київська нота); Scribe Hand A (fine Ukrainian semi-uncial півустав); 12 rastrum-ruled staves per page; C-clef on 3rd/2nd line; Custodes at staff ends
philology_art_concordance: Authentic Kyivan Recension; Yas. № 38 (Варшава, БН, 12052 III)

incipit_diplomatic: Тя неизреченную радость приимшую рождшая живодавца своего господа спаси тя величающа.
incipit_english: Thee Who didst receive ineffable joy, having given birth to Thy Life-giver, O Lord save those who magnify Thee...
musical_paleography: Kyivan square notation (київська нота); Scribe Hand A (fine Ukrainian semi-uncial півустав); 12 rastrum-ruled staves per page; C-clef on 3rd/2nd line; Custodes at staff ends
philology_art_concordance: Authentic Kyivan Recension; Yas. № 38 (Варшава, БН, 12052 III)

incipit_diplomatic: Радуйся чистая пресвятая дѣво дщи напрепѣтая, похвала славнѣйшая матере святая.
incipit_reconstructed: Радуйся чистая пресвятая Дѣво дщи препѣтая
incipit_english: Rejoice, O pure, most holy Virgin, all-hymned daughter, most glorious praise, holy Mother...

incipit_diplomatic: Пріидите вси... ублажимъ радоватися пречистую богородицу велегласно величаемъ.
incipit_english: Come, all generations, let us bless the Most Pure Theotokos, loudly magnifying her...
musical_paleography: Kyivan square notation (київська нота); Scribe Hand A (fine Ukrainian semi-uncial півустав); 12 rastrum-ruled staves per page; C-clef on 3rd/2nd line; Custodes at staff ends
philology_art_concordance: Authentic Kyivan Recension; Yas. № 38 (Варшава, БН, 12052 III)

incipit_diplomatic: Маніемъ твоимъ на земный образъ преложися первѣе раливаемое водное естество господи: тѣмъ немокренно пѣшешествовавъ ізраиль поетъ тебѣ пѣснь побѣдную.
incipit_reconstructed: Маніем Твоим на земный образ преложися
incipit_english: By Thy nod, the nature of the waters, previously fluid, was turned into dry land, O Lord; wherefore Israel, dryshod walking through, singeth unto Thee a song of victory...
musical_paleography: Kyivan square notation (київська нота); Scribe Hand A (fine Ukrainian semi-uncial півустав); 12 rastrum-ruled staves per page; C-clef on 3rd/2nd line; Custodes at staff ends

incipit_diplomatic: Потопи погуби фараона со оружиемъ сокрушая брань мышцею высокою поетъ ему яко прославися.
incipit_english: He drowned and destroyed Pharaoh with his weaponry, crushing the warfare with a high arm: let us sing unto Him, for He hath been glorified...
musical_paleography: Kyivan square notation (київська нота); Scribe Hand A (fine Ukrainian semi-uncial півустав); 12 rastrum-ruled staves per page; C-clef on 3rd/2nd line; Custodes at staff ends
philology_art_concordance: Authentic Kyivan Recension; Yas. № 38 (Варшава, БН, 12052 III)

incipit_diplomatic: Прѣдшедшему богу фараона во мори чермное потопльшему пѣснь победную поимъ яко прославися...
incipit_reconstructed: Предшедшему Богу Фараона во мори Чермном
incipit_english: Unto God who went before, Who drowned Pharaoh in the Red Sea, let us sing a song of victory, for He hath been glorified...
musical_paleography: Kyivan square notation (київська нота); Scribe Hand A (fine Ukrainian semi-uncial півустав); 12 rastrum-ruled staves per page; C-clef on 3rd/2nd line; Custodes at staff ends
philology_art_concordance: Authentic Kyivan Recension; Yas. № 38 (Варшава, БН, 12052 III)

incipit_diplomatic: Теплѣйше любящымъ бога во глубинѣ яви и ветхіи врагъ побежденъ бысть: единому воспоимъ яко прославися.
incipit_english: To those who warmly love God, even in the deep He appeared, and the ancient foe was conquered: let us sing unto the One, for He hath been glorified...
musical_paleography: Kyivan square notation (київська нота); Scribe Hand A (fine Ukrainian semi-uncial півустав); 12 rastrum-ruled staves per page; C-clef on 3rd/2nd line; Custodes at staff ends
philology_art_concordance: Authentic Kyivan Recension; Yas. № 38 (Варшава, БН, 12052 III)

incipit_diplomatic: Поимъ господеви потопльшему фараона во мори чермнѣ побѣдную пѣснь яко прославися.
incipit_reconstructed: Поим Господеви потопльшему Фараона во мори Чермнѣ
incipit_english: Let us sing unto the Lord Who drowned Pharaoh in the Red Sea, a triumphant hymn, for He hath been glorified...
musical_paleography: Kyivan square notation (київська нота); Scribe Hand A (fine Ukrainian semi-uncial півустав); 12 rastrum-ruled staves per page; C-clef on 3rd/2nd line; Custodes at staff ends
philology_art_concordance: Authentic Kyivan Recension; Yas. № 38 (Варшава, БН, 12052 III)

incipit_diplomatic: Видѣте видѣте яко азъ есмь въ мори чермнѣмь наставивы древлѣ ізраиля тѣмь поимъ...
incipit_english: See, see that I am He, Who of old guided Israel in the Red Sea: wherefore let us sing...
musical_paleography: Kyivan square notation (київська нота); Scribe Hand A (fine Ukrainian semi-uncial півустав); 12 rastrum-ruled staves per page; C-clef on 3rd/2nd line; Custodes at staff ends
philology_art_concordance: Authentic Kyivan Recension; Yas. № 38 (Варшава, БН, 12052 III)

incipit_diplomatic: Омни него яко благаго человѣколюбца христа спаса всего мира единаго человѣколюбца.
incipit_english: Reckon Him as the good Lover of mankind, Christ the Savior of the whole world, the only Lover of mankind...
musical_paleography: Kyivan square notation (київська нота); Scribe Hand A (fine Ukrainian semi-uncial півустав); 12 rastrum-ruled staves per page; C-clef on 3rd/2nd line; Custodes at staff ends
philology_art_concordance: Pre-Nikonian Authentic Kyivan Recension; Yas. № 38 (Варшава, БН, 12052 III)

incipit_diplomatic: В началѣ небеса всесилни словомъ утверже господи спасителю и всетворящи духомъ божіи всю силу ихъ на недвижимомъ камени исповѣданія твоего утверди.
incipit_reconstructed: В началѣ небеса всесильным словом утверждь
incipit_english: In the beginning, by Thy almighty Word Thou didst establish the heavens, O Lord our Savior, and all their host by the all-creating Spirit of God: establish me upon the immovable rock of Thy confession...
musical_paleography: Kyivan square notation (київська нота); Scribe Hand A (fine Ukrainian semi-uncial півустав); 12 rastrum-ruled staves per page; C-clef on 3rd/2nd line; Custodes at staff ends
philology_art_concordance: Authentic Kyivan Recension; Yas. № 38 (Варшава, БН, 12052 III)

incipit_diplomatic: Стяживы ны люди учениковъ твоихъ...
incipit_reconstructed: Стяживый ны в стяжаніе честною Твоею Кровію
incipit_english: Having gained us as Thy possession by Thy precious Blood, O Christ...
musical_paleography: Kyivan square notation (київська нота); Scribe Hand A (fine Ukrainian semi-uncial півустав); 12 rastrum-ruled staves per page; C-clef on 3rd/2nd line; Custodes at staff ends
philology_art_concordance: Authentic Kyivan Recension; Yas. № 38 (Варшава, БН, 12052 III)

incipit_diplomatic: Отверзися сердце мое господевъ вознесеся рогъ мои во бозѣ моемъ разширишася на враги моя уста моя.
incipit_english: My heart is established in the Lord, my horn is exalted in my God; my mouth is enlarged over my enemies...
musical_paleography: Kyivan square notation (київська нота); Scribe Hand A (fine Ukrainian semi-uncial півустав); 12 rastrum-ruled staves per page; C-clef on 3rd/2nd line; Custodes at staff ends
philology_art_concordance: Authentic Kyivan Recension; Yas. № 38 (Варшава, БН, 12052 III)

incipit_diplomatic: Утвердися въ крови честнѣи христа пречистая и конепрестанно поемъ тя богородице чистая господи спаса душа наша.
incipit_english: Established in the precious Blood of Christ, O Most Pure One, unceasingly we hymn thee, O pure Theotokos, O Lord, Savior of our souls...
musical_paleography: Kyivan square notation (київська нота); Scribe Hand A (fine Ukrainian semi-uncial півустав); 12 rastrum-ruled staves per page; C-clef on 3rd/2nd line; Custodes at staff ends
philology_art_concordance: Authentic Kyivan Recension; Yas. № 38 (Варшава, БН, 12052 III)

incipit_diplomatic: Тоже небеса словомъ земное основаніе укрѣпи на водахъ мнозехъ утверди мя господи во любви твоей...
incipit_reconstructed: Иже небеса словом и земное основаніе укрѣпи
incipit_english: Who didst establish the heavens by Thy word and strengthen the foundation of the earth upon the many waters, establish me, O Lord, in Thy love...
musical_paleography: Kyivan square notation (київська нота); Scribe Hand A (fine Ukrainian semi-uncial півустав); 12 rastrum-ruled staves per page; C-clef on 3rd/2nd line; Custodes at staff ends
philology_art_concordance: Authentic Kyivan Recension; Yas. № 38 (Варшава, БН, 12052 III)

incipit_diplomatic: Ѡтца не отлучися сшедъ на землю христе боже таинству слышавъ смотреніа твоего и прославихъ тя человѣколюбче.
incipit_reconstructed: Отца не отлучився сшед на землю
incipit_english: Without leaving the Father, having come down to earth, O Christ God, having heard the mystery of Thy dispensation, I glorified Thee, O Lover of mankind...
musical_paleography: Kyivan square notation (київська нота); Scribe Hand A (fine Ukrainian semi-uncial півустав); 12 rastrum-ruled staves per page; C-clef on 3rd/2nd line; Custodes at staff ends
philology_art_concordance: Authentic Kyivan Recension; Yas. № 38 (Варшава, БН, 12052 III)

incipit_diplomatic: Смотряи пророкъ послѣднаго ти христе пришествія вопияше твоя господи слышахъ силу яко вся спасти владыко пришелъ еси.
incipit_reconstructed: Смотряя пророк послѣдняго Ти Христе пришествія
incipit_english: Foreseeing Thy last coming, O Christ, the prophet cried aloud: O Lord, I have heard Thy power, for Thou art come to save all, O Master...
musical_paleography: Kyivan square notation (київська нота); Scribe Hand A (fine Ukrainian semi-uncial півустав); 12 rastrum-ruled staves per page; C-clef on 3rd/2nd line; Custodes at staff ends
philology_art_concordance: Authentic Kyivan Recension; Yas. № 38 (Варшава, БН, 12052 III)

incipit_diplomatic: Покрыла есть небеса христе смотреніемъ твоимъ добродѣтели неизреченныя и просвѣтилъ еси человѣколюбче.
incipit_reconstructed: Покрыла есть небеса Христе добродѣтель Твоя
incipit_english: Thy ineffable virtue hath covered the heavens by Thy dispensation, O Christ, and Thou hast enlightened all, O Lover of mankind...
musical_paleography: Kyivan square notation (київська нота); Scribe Hand A (fine Ukrainian semi-uncial півустав); 12 rastrum-ruled staves per page; C-clef on 3rd/2nd line; Custodes at staff ends
philology_art_concordance: Authentic Kyivan Recension; Yas. № 38 (Варшава, БН, 12052 III)

incipit_diplomatic: Услышахъ слухъ твои и оубояхся разумѣхъ...
incipit_reconstructed: Услышах слух Твой Господи и убояхся
incipit_english: I heard Thy report, O Lord, and was afraid; I understood Thy works, and was filled with awe...
musical_paleography: Kyivan square notation (київська нота); Scribe Hand A (fine Ukrainian semi-uncial півустав); 12 rastrum-ruled staves per page; C-clef on 3rd/2nd line; Custodes at staff ends
philology_art_concordance: Authentic Kyivan Recension; Yas. № 38 (Варшава, БН, 12052 III)

incipit_diplomatic: Новое пришествіе твое христе увѣдѣвъ пророкъ аввакумъ вопияше: слава силѣ твоей.
incipit_english: Perceiving Thy new coming, O Christ, the prophet Habakkuk cried aloud: Glory to Thy power...
musical_paleography: Kyivan square notation (київська нота); Scribe Hand A (fine Ukrainian semi-uncial півустав); 12 rastrum-ruled staves per page; C-clef on 3rd/2nd line; Custodes at staff ends
philology_art_concordance: Authentic Kyivan Recension; Yas. № 38 (Варшава, БН, 12052 III)

incipit_diplomatic: Небеса покрыла есть добродѣтель твоя господи и твоего хваленія вся земля исполнишася, слава силѣ твоей господи.
incipit_reconstructed: Небеса покрыла есть добродѣтель Твоя Господи
incipit_english: Thy virtue, O Lord, hath covered the heavens, and all the earth was filled with Thy praise: Glory to Thy power, O Lord...
musical_paleography: Kyivan square notation (київська нота); Scribe Hand A (fine Ukrainian semi-uncial півустав); 12 rastrum-ruled staves per page; C-clef on 3rd/2nd line; Custodes at staff ends
philology_art_concordance: Authentic Kyivan Recension; Yas. № 38 (Варшава, БН, 12052 III)

incipit_diplomatic: Нощь свѣтла невѣрнымъ явѣ, вѣрнымъ же просвѣщеніе въ сладости словесъ твоихъ; сего ради к тебе утренюю и поспола твоє...
incipit_english: The night is dark unto the unbelieving, but unto the faithful light and enlightenment in the sweetness of Thy words; wherefore early unto Thee do I rise...
musical_paleography: Kyivan square notation (київська нота); Scribe Hand A (fine Ukrainian semi-uncial півустав); 12 rastrum-ruled staves per page; C-clef on 3rd/2nd line; Custodes at staff ends
philology_art_concordance: Authentic Kyivan Recension; Yas. № 38 (Варшава, БН, 12052 III)

incipit_diplomatic: Страха ради твоего господи...
incipit_english: Through fear of Thee, O Lord, we conceived in the womb, and were in pain with the spirit of salvation...
liturgical_title: Pentecost (Descent of the Holy Spirit) Canon Irmos Ode 6 (Tone 6)
musical_paleography: Kyivan square notation (київська нота); Scribe Hand A (fine Ukrainian semi-uncial півустав); 12 rastrum-ruled staves per page; C-clef on 3rd/2nd line; Custodes at staff ends
philology_art_concordance: Authentic Kyivan Recension; Yas. № 38 (Варшава, БН, 12052 III)

incipit_diplomatic: Къ тебѣ утренюю иже изъ полы тобою милосерде господи омирая греха ми душа свѣтъ твоихъ заповѣдей твоихъ настави.
incipit_reconstructed: К тебѣ утренюю Иже исполнивый милосердіем
incipit_english: Early unto Thee do I wake, O Merciful Lord, cleansing my soul from sins; guide me by the light of Thy commandments...
musical_paleography: Kyivan square notation (київська нота); Scribe Hand A (fine Ukrainian semi-uncial півустав); 12 rastrum-ruled staves per page; C-clef on 3rd/2nd line; Custodes at staff ends
philology_art_concordance: Authentic Kyivan Recension; Yas. № 38 (Варшава, БН, 12052 III)

incipit_diplomatic: Утренюююще христе тя славословимъ...
incipit_english: Rising early from the night, O Christ, we glorify Thee...
musical_paleography: Kyivan square notation (київська нота); Scribe Hand A (fine Ukrainian semi-uncial півустав); 12 rastrum-ruled staves per page; C-clef on 3rd/2nd line; Custodes at staff ends
philology_art_concordance: Authentic Kyivan Recension; Yas. № 38 (Варшава, БН, 12052 III)

incipit_diplomatic: Ѡтъ тмадино страшную нощь ми свѣтъ разумный и непорожде... тьму бездны прогнаи свѣтодавче споси миру содѣтелю.
incipit_english: Dispelling the fearful night and darkness of the abyss, O Giver of light, grant us spiritual light, Savior and Creator of the world...
musical_paleography: Kyivan square notation (київська нота); Scribe Hand A (fine Ukrainian semi-uncial півустав); 12 rastrum-ruled staves per page; C-clef on 3rd/2nd line; Custodes at staff ends
philology_art_concordance: Authentic Kyivan Recension; Yas. № 38 (Варшава, БН, 12052 III)

incipit_diplomatic: Утренюетъ духъ мои къ тебѣ христе боже зане свѣтъ повелѣнія твоя быша исцѣленіа рабомъ твоимъ человѣколюбче.
incipit_reconstructed: Утренюет дух мой к Тебѣ Христе Боже
incipit_english: My spirit waketh early unto Thee, O Christ God, for Thy commandments are light, bringing healing unto Thy servants, O Lover of mankind...
musical_paleography: Kyivan square notation (київська нота); Scribe Hand A (fine Ukrainian semi-uncial півустав); 12 rastrum-ruled staves per page; C-clef on 3rd/2nd line; Custodes at staff ends
philology_art_concordance: Authentic Kyivan Recension; Yas. № 38 (Варшава, БН, 12052 III)

incipit_diplomatic: Господи боже мои нощи утренюю тебе... самолюбо даждь ми отпусти прегрешенія моя...
incipit_reconstructed: Господи Боже мой от нощи утренюю к Тебѣ
incipit_english: O Lord my God, early from the night I wake unto Thee... grant me remission of my sins...
musical_paleography: Kyivan square notation (київська нота); Scribe Hand A (fine Ukrainian semi-uncial півустав); 12 rastrum-ruled staves per page; C-clef on 3rd/2nd line; Custodes at staff ends
philology_art_concordance: Authentic Kyivan Recension; Yas. № 38 (Варшава, БН, 12052 III)

incipit_diplomatic: Плавающаго въ молвѣ житейскихъ попеченій с кораблѣмъ потопляемь грѣхми и душетлѣнному звѣрю примѣтаема яко іона христе вопію ти: из смертныя глубины возведи мя.
incipit_english: Sailing upon the surge of worldly cares, shipwrecked by sins and cast unto the soul-corrupting beast, like Jonah, O Christ, I cry unto Thee: lead me up from the depths of death...
musical_paleography: Kyivan square notation (київська нота); Scribe Hand A (fine Ukrainian semi-uncial півустав); 12 rastrum-ruled staves per page; C-clef on 3rd/2nd line; Custodes at staff ends
philology_art_concordance: Authentic Kyivan Recension; Yas. № 38 (Варшава, БН, 12052 III)

incipit_diplomatic: Возопихъ господи во скорби моей к тебе и возведи от тли животъ мои многомилостиве.
incipit_reconstructed: Возопих Господи во скорби моей к Тебѣ
incipit_english: I cried, O Lord, in mine affliction unto Thee, and lead up my life from corruption, O Greatly Merciful One...
musical_paleography: Kyivan square notation (київська нота); Scribe Hand A (fine Ukrainian semi-uncial півустав); 12 rastrum-ruled staves per page; C-clef on 3rd/2nd line; Custodes at staff ends
philology_art_concordance: Authentic Kyivan Recension; Yas. № 38 (Варшава, БН, 12052 III)

incipit_diplomatic: Іона изъ чрева адова возопи: аще животомъ моимъ избыхъ истлѣнія своего...
incipit_english: Jonah cried aloud from the belly of hades: if in my life I escaped from corruption...
musical_paleography: Kyivan square notation (київська нота); Scribe Hand A (fine Ukrainian semi-uncial півустав); 12 rastrum-ruled staves per page; C-clef on 3rd/2nd line; Custodes at staff ends
philology_art_concordance: Authentic Kyivan Recension; Yas. № 38 (Варшава, БН, 12052 III)

incipit_diplomatic: Во глубинѣ грѣховнѣй вопадаюся...
incipit_english: Tempest-tossed in the deep of sins, like Jonah from the sea monster I cry: lead up my life from corruption...
liturgical_title: Sunday of Myrrh-bearers Canon Irmos Ode 6 (Tone 2)
musical_paleography: Kyivan square notation (київська нота); Scribe Hand A (fine Ukrainian semi-uncial півустав); 12 rastrum-ruled staves per page; C-clef on 3rd/2nd line; Custodes at staff ends
philology_art_concordance: Authentic Kyivan Recension; Yas. № 38 (Варшава, БН, 12052 III)

incipit_diplomatic: Тебе во пещи пламеннои отроцы огне пламенную хладѣюще показаша единого поющи и глаголющи превозносимыи отецъ нашихъ боже благословенъ еси.
incipit_english: Thee in the fiery furnace the youths showed cooling the fiery flame, singing and saying: O supremely exalted God of our fathers, blessed art Thou...
musical_paleography: Kyivan square notation (київська нота); Scribe Hand A (fine Ukrainian semi-uncial півустав); 12 rastrum-ruled staves per page; C-clef on 3rd/2nd line; Custodes at staff ends
philology_art_concordance: Authentic Kyivan Recension; Yas. № 38 (Варшава, БН, 12052 III)

incipit_diplomatic: Иже в пещи огненной ввержени бывше преподобныи отроци огнь на хладъ преложи во спѣваніемъ сице вопіяху: благословенъ еси господи боже отецъ нашихъ.
incipit_reconstructed: Иже в пещи огненнѣй ввержени бывше
incipit_english: Cast into the fiery furnace, the holy youths turned the fire into dew, singing and crying aloud: Blessed art Thou, O Lord God of our fathers...
musical_paleography: Kyivan square notation (київська нота); Scribe Hand A (fine Ukrainian semi-uncial півустав); 12 rastrum-ruled staves per page; C-clef on 3rd/2nd line; Custodes at staff ends
philology_art_concordance: Authentic Kyivan Recension; Yas. № 38 (Варшава, БН, 12052 III)

incipit_diplomatic: Пещь горащая прохлаждашеся спасе отроки же спасе хвалящи тя и глаголюща: благословенъ еси господи боже отецъ нашихъ.
incipit_english: The burning furnace was bedewed, O Savior, and preserved the youths praising Thee and saying: Blessed art Thou, O Lord God of our fathers...
musical_paleography: Kyivan square notation (київська нота); Scribe Hand A (fine Ukrainian semi-uncial півустав); 12 rastrum-ruled staves per page; C-clef on 3rd/2nd line; Custodes at staff ends
philology_art_concordance: Authentic Kyivan Recension; Yas. № 38 (Варшава, БН, 12052 III)
